question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Stationary
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stationary"** means not moving or not intended to be moved. (स्थिर)

 
 
• **Example: **The car remained **stationary **while waiting for the traffic light to change.
 
 
 
• **"Still"** refers to something that is not moving or making a sound; it remains in a fixed position. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **The lake was so **still **that it looked like a mirror.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mobile **(चल): Able to move or be moved freely or easily.

 
 
• **Example:** The mobile phone allows people to communicate from anywhere.
 
 
 
• **Portable **(पोर्टेबल): Able to be easily carried or moved, especially because being of a lighter and smaller version than usual.
 
 
• **Example: **The portable charger is very convenient for travel.
 
 
 
• **Swindle** (धोखा देना): To cheat (someone) out of money or assets.
 
 
• **Example:** He was swindled out of his life savings by a con artist.
